observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a single wooden pallet in a warehouse setting.
Photo 2 shows a stack of multiple wooden pallets outdoors.
The pallets appear to be made of pine or similar softwood.
No brand names, logos, or model numbers are visible on any of the pallets.
The wood shows some natural wear and discoloration, consistent with used pallets.

claims.claim: Wooden pallets are the backbone of supply chain logistics, manufacturing, and warehousing, while...
Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added. Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The pallet may be structurally weak or have hidden rot.
risks.proof: A video showing the pallet being loaded with heavy items or a close-up of the wood grain.

risks.risk: The pallet may be a 'repallet' (reused pallet) with a short lifespan.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's identification plate.

risks.risk: The pallet may be missing essential components like corner blocks or side rails.
risks.proof: A photo of the pallet from the side and the underside.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate (usually on the side or end).
Photo of the pallet from the side and underside to check for missing parts.
Video of the pallet being loaded with heavy items to test its strength.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
